operations.after: 侵略一個國家；侵犯某人的隱私

operations.after: 使某人熟悉……；使自己熟悉……；熟悉／認識……

operations.after: abolish + N; abolish the death penalty

operations.before: 廢除……；廢除以致於……
operations.after: 廢除……；廢除死刑

operations.before: enlarge + N; enlarge to V; an/the enlarge
operations.after: enlargement of sth; an enlargement of a photograph

operations.before: 擴大……；enlarge 後接 to 不定詞；該擴大
operations.after: 某事物的擴大；一張放大的照片

operations.before: 化學；化學過程
operations.after: 化學；化學過程；（感情上的）吸引／來電

operations.before: the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions; the chemical composition and properties of a substance or object
operations.after: the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions; the chemical composition and properties of a substance or object; the attraction or connection that people feel toward each other

operations.before: a person who is of equal standing with another in a group; a nobleman (duke or marquis or earl or viscount or baron) who is a member of the British peerage
operations.after: a person who is of equal standing with another in a group; a nobleman (duke or marquis or earl or viscount or baron) who is a member of the British peerage; (v.) to look closely or carefully at something

operations.before: of or relating to or caused by magnetism; having the properties of a magnet; i.e. of attracting iron or steel
operations.after: of or relating to or caused by magnetism; having the properties of a magnet; i.e. of attracting iron or steel; having a powerful attraction or charm

operations.before: 親密的；私人的；祕密的；暗示
operations.after: （形容詞）親密的；私人的；祕密的；（名詞）知己；密友；（動詞）暗示；正式告知

operations.before: 祝福
operations.after: 祝福；福氣

operations.before: 領導者；指揮者；售票員；嚮導
operations.after: 領導者；指揮者；售票員；嚮導；列車長；導體

operations.before: the person who leads a musical group; a substance that readily conducts e.g. electricity and heat
operations.after: the person who leads a musical group; a substance that readily conducts e.g. electricity and heat; a person who checks tickets and assists passengers on a train

operations.before: a state of conflict between persons; a state of conflict between colors; (v.) to come into conflict or disagreement
operations.after: a state of conflict between persons; a state of conflict between colors; (v.) to come into conflict or disagreement; (n.) a loud noise made when hard objects strike together; (v.) to strike together with a loud noise

operations.before: make larger; become larger or bigger; the state of being enlarged; a photographic print that has been enlarged
operations.after: the act or result of making something larger; the state of being enlarged; a photographic print that has been enlarged

operations.before: profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger; a severe affliction
operations.after: profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger; a severe affliction; a spell intended to bring harm; (v.) to use offensive language or express a wish that harm will happen to someone

operations.before: something used to beautify; an award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event
operations.after: the act of making something look attractive; something used to beautify; an award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event

operations.before: 熟人；結識某人；與某人相識
operations.after: 熟人；結識某人；熟悉某事

operations.before: adj./n.
operations.after: adj./n./v.

operations.before: adj. having a very close and warm relationship with someone; very private and personal; n. a close friend
operations.after: very close and warm in friendship, or private and personal; a close friend or confidant; to hint indirectly or make something known formally
